observations.finding: NewReport sends api.post(/expenses) without explicit Idempotency-Key and has no manual saved-command slot. Server intentionally creates a new legacy-manual UUID for each unkeyed standalone report; retries may create independent drafts.
observations.classification: source-confirmed gap; no browser/API/PG duplicate diagnostic performed in this preflight

observations.finding: Preview sums Number strings; amount and VAT inputs have no field-specific decimal/precision/range validation. Server rounds individual lines with q2/ROUND_HALF_UP.
Success resets/closes form and starts unawaited broad expense invalidation; no committed ID/readback outcome is rendered. Editing, add/remove and Cancel remain active while save is pending.

Manual component itself does not gate Save/open by expense.write or explicit scope; server route and live membership checks remain authoritative. Existing api.ts already adds expected identity headers and global identity-owned query client remounts subtree.
observations.classification: source-confirmed UI gap; existing isolation protections preserved

observations.finding: Both checkSavedInvoiceCommand and successful invoiceCommand lookup paths delete metadata on any HTTP 200 before validating operation/target/result. Raw /result endpoint cannot prove typed status/operation binding to the manual caller.

invoiceCommand awaits SHA-256 before creating a new key/reading the saved slot; the manual event handler must capture stable key, scope and immutable payload synchronously and coalesce callbacks before that await.
observations.classification: source-confirmed implementation constraint; no browser race diagnostic run

endpoints.create: POST /expenses -> ExpenseReportDetail, HTTP201; explicit Idempotency-Key supported; caller transaction commits report/items/command/audit together
endpoints.raw_snapshot: GET /expenses/commands/{key}/result -> saved result_json only; existing selected/import/remove callers use this endpoint
endpoints.current_report: GET /expenses/{report_id} -> current detail, separate from committed receipt snapshot

smallest_seams: NewReport synchronous event capture of stable key, scope and deep copied payload in useRef/in-memory intention; mutation variables should be frozen capture, with concurrent callbacks coalesced. Distinct /expenses/manual slot; key/digest only persisted by default.
Use bounded nonnegative plain-decimal parser for amount/VAT, BigInt cents, supported total/range and decimalMoney formatter. Preserve legacy server q2 and zero-draft semantics.

Add optional lookup-result validator/adapter to command helpers, default identity for existing callers. Invoke before metadata removal on every lookup-success branch; manual adapter uses typed status envelope and returns its validated report snapshot. Test helper-wide callers if changing shared seam.
Render committed ID and explicit refresh/unknown/current-read states; await targeted report/list/summary readback. Preserve late-session filtering and the globally identity-owned QueryClient.
Extend existing real PG/browser expense harness, with zero-POST lookup assertions separated from fixture setup. Do not introduce table/job/provider/decimal library/new execution engine.
